fixes.area: peds crowd the camera-to-player corridor (player occluded)
fixes.problem: hero_noon: the green-top and white-shirt walkers stand between the lens and the player and hide almost all of her. hero_night: the green-top walker overlaps the player. hero: a white-shirt walker 2-3 m from the lens is the largest figure. The 3.5 m camera bubble (peds.js:126) only protects the lens, and the player sits 4.4 m out. The landing loop (inset 9 m, x 20-150) and the 3 'near the spawn edge' strollers with +-3 m jitter (peds.js:57) spawn on the spawn itself. At shot frames 28-40 nobody has had time to walk out.
fixes.fix: peds.js: add const corridorD = (x,z) => distance from (x,z) to the segment camera->player extended 2 m past the player. In add() (and the populate loops), re-roll any spawn point with corridorD < 2.2 or within 3.0 m of the player (max 8 tries, then the next waypoint). In S.update, after the camera bubble: if (!player.vehicle && corridorD(nx,nz) < 1.8), push laterally away from the segment by (1.8-d)*2.4*dt and set p.speed *= 0.9. Replace the 'keep apart from the player' slow-down at d2p < 1.4 with a push at d2p < 2.5. Drop the +-3 m jitter on the spawn-edge strollers (line 57) and require hypot(w - PLAYER_SPAWN) > 10.

fixes.area: small casters float (bench at noon, player feet, most peds)

Only the tank-top ped shows a blob at noon. Benches are an instanced kit with castShadow=true (props.js:81), so this is a caster/PCSS loss on 0.08 m seat slabs, not a flag. This is the second round with the issue (P0 by rule).
fixes.fix: (1) One-frame diagnosis: tools/qa/one.mjs hero_noon ?q=ultra. If the bench shadow appears, it is texel/penumbra: raise the PCSS minUV clamp to 1.5 texels for blockers < 1 m above the receiver (pcss.js:98) and give the seat 0.12 m thickness (props.js:71 box h 0.08 -> 0.12). (2) Robust and cheap either way: a soft blob decal (cookbook/fx/decals.js), r 0.55 m under the player and peds within SHADOW_R, a 2.0 x 0.7 m blob under each bench instance, and a 1.2 x 2.4 m blob under cars. Strength 0.35*day + 0.2*night, multiplied into the ground albedo.

verdict_note: The reduced overall went 5.35 (r4) -> 5.65 (r6), and this critic is at 5.73, so the two-round gain is under 0.5 (plateau rule). Most of it is an execution plateau: 14 of the r6 fixes are not in source (see measurements.r6_fixes_landed_in_source). The ped corridor, street prime and contact shadow P0s plus the four unlanded P1 palette/vegetation items are the shortest path to 6.5+.
